title: Rule: least code for the agreed outcome
goal: No unrequested features, options, single-use abstraction or impossible-case handling
acceptance: New behaviour scenario whose task tempts an option or extra export, graded without a model
privacy: Rule and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories; no personal data.
escalation: Rule text differing materially from the accepted draft goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one line plus a new scenario and its fixture test. Not a measurement.
